mode: Real React components; fixture catalog, HTTP and OAuth navigation. No iyzico or Google transaction.
checks: Provider deep link survives region edits; an unavailable provider is never silently replaced.
Provider availability comes from HTTP slots; Today stays hidden when empty, Tomorrow is shown only after a successful slot response.
Two providers expose different prices; switching packages retains the explicitly chosen provider and updates its price/duration.
Checkout scope, exclusions, address, duration, total, cancellation/refund terms and one visible payment CTA fit eight viewport widths.
One final click creates the hold and starts the existing checkout API; initialization failure preserves access to the same order.
Successful mocked checkout redirects to the validated sandbox host; the sandbox page itself is intercepted test HTML.
Guest login navigation restores the summary, service/provider/package/date/time/address draft; a newly unavailable slot blocks payment after reload.
Disabled session storage prevents the login redirect and keeps selections visible, with an actionable error.
Slot API failure disables purchase and hides unverified quick days.
Expired hold disables payment and offers a fresh booking without inventing a new server status.
5% platform fee is separate from the service price, total is 892.50 TRY, unchecked explicit consent blocks payment and exact total/version reach the order request (mock APIs).
Server fee-change conflict refreshes the displayed quote and clears consent before another attempt.
Quote connection failure never silently charges a zero fee or enables payment.
